claims.content: The Auctioneer analyzes inventory availability and aging to gain visibility into currently available auction inventory, including items that are not part of available auction inventory, by generating a detailed report with various grouping and filtering options.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Inventory Performance & Aging Report interface, including search capabilities and grouping options (Retail Category, Product Type, etc.), is available within the Auction Administration system.
The Auctioneer selects the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' option from the Reports Menu in the Auction Administration system.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer selects the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' option from the Reports Menu in the Auction Administration system.

claims.content: The Auctioneer selects the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' option from the Reports Menu in the Auction Administration system.
The Auctioneer uses the 'search for auction items' search box to enter keywords, optionally using wildcard characters (% or *).
The Auctioneer chooses between 'Items currently online only' and 'All sellable auction inventory' using radio button options.
The Auctioneer selects options to show items with or without images and with or without a valid location via radio buttons.
The Auctioneer selects one or more grouping options (e.g., Retail Category, Product Type, Gemstone, Brand, Inventory Realm) from the Group By scrolling list box.
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Submit' button to generate the report.

The system displays the Results section with columns based on selected groupings and predefined fields such as Product ID, Active Date, Buyer Name, Cost, Available quantities, and Red/White status totals.
The Auctioneer reviews the Summary Section showing SKU Count, piece count, extended cost, and max unit costs.

The system displays a Results section containing columns based on the selected groupings and predefined fields such as Product ID, Active Date, Buyer Name, Cost, Available quantities, and Red/White status totals.
The system displays a Summary Section showing aggregated data including SKU Count, piece count, extended cost, and max unit costs.
The Auctioneer has gained visibility into currently available auction inventory, including items that are not part of available auction inventory, through the generated detailed report.
